description: This Scala source file defines the StagesResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for retrieving information about Spark stages, including stage lists, details, attempts, task summaries, task lists, and task tables. It is part of the Spark Web UI API.

classes.name: StagesResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for Spark stage data.

methods.name: stageList
methods.description: Returns a list of stages filtered by status, details, summaries, quantiles, and task status.

methods.name: stageData
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific stage by stageId.

methods.name: oneAttemptData
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific stage attempt.

methods.name: taskSummary
methods.description: Provides task metric distributions for a stage attempt.

methods.name: taskList
methods.description: Returns a list of tasks for a stage attempt with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: taskTable
methods.description: Provides task data formatted for DataTables, with server-side search and pagination.

methods.name: doPagination
methods.description: Handles server-side pagination and sorting for task lists.

methods.name: filterTaskList
methods.description: Filters tasks based on a search string.

methods.name: parseQuantileString
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of quantiles into a double array.
